requirement: The system shall write a log entry for every administrative action, capturing the actor, the target and the time of the action.
The audit log shall record each state change on business entities with the entity type, entity id, previous state, new state and actor.
The user performs an operation; the system emits a structured log line including correlation id, user id, operation name and outcome.
The system shall retain audit entries for a minimum of seven years and shall reject any attempt to purge entries younger than that.
As a compliance officer, I want to search audit entries by actor and date range so that I can investigate a specific period.
As a security engineer, I want to see an alert when the rate of failed logins from one IP exceeds a threshold within a short window.
The audit log must be append-only; no user-facing operation may modify or delete an existing entry.
The audit table shall ensure that every entry has a non-blank actor, a non-blank action and a timestamp, and that no two identical entries share the same second.
code:
-- audit log table
CREATE TABLE audit_log (
    entry_id    BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    actor_id    VARCHAR(64)  NOT NULL,
    action      VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    target_type VARCHAR(60)  NOT NULL,
    target_id   VARCHAR(80)  NOT NULL,
    occurred_at TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    detail      TEXT,
    CONSTRAINT audit_actor_not_blank  CHECK (length(trim(actor_id)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT audit_action_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(action)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT audit_target_not_blank CHECK (length(trim(target_id)) > 0),
    CONSTRAINT audit_unique_per_second UNIQUE (actor_id, action, target_type, target_id, occurred_at)
);

CREATE INDEX audit_actor_idx ON audit_log (actor_id, occurred_at DESC);
CREATE INDEX audit_target_idx ON audit_log (target_type, target_id, occurred_at DESC);
hard_negatives:
-- operational error log table
CREATE TABLE error_log (
    error_id     BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    level        VARCHAR(10)  NOT NULL,
    message      VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
    stack_trace  TEXT,
    occurred_at  TIMESTAMP    NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT error_level_chk CHECK (level IN ('WARN','ERROR','FATAL'))
);
-- slow query log table
CREATE TABLE slow_query_log (
    query_id       BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    query_hash     CHAR(64) NOT NULL,
    duration_ms    BIGINT   NOT NULL,
    occurred_at    TIMESTAMP NOT NULL,
    CONSTRAINT slow_query_duration_positive CHECK (duration_ms > 0)
);

requirement: Only users with the AUDITOR role may query the audit log; all other users must be refused access.
The system shall compress audit entries older than thirty days into daily summary records, retaining the daily counts per actor and action.
